title: More to be proud of than you think

accomplishments.text: Helped a new teammate learn the team's weekly reporting process by walking them through it step by step.
accomplishments.source_excerpt: I showed a new teammate how our weekly reporting process works, step by step.

accomplishments.text: Volunteered at a neighborhood food pantry and helped organize donated items so the team could find them.
accomplishments.source_excerpt: At the neighborhood food pantry I helped organize donated items so the team could find them.

accomplishments.text: Made time for a short walk on three days last week while navigating a difficult job search.
accomplishments.source_excerpt: Last week I took a short walk on three days even though the job search has been difficult.

encouragement: You have made time to help someone learn, contribute to your neighborhood, and take a small step for yourself. Those experiences still count during a difficult search.
A slow response or a rejection does not erase what you have done. You can return to these examples without needing to turn every day into a productivity test.
next_steps: Choose one work example and jot down what you explained to your teammate. That detail could help you describe your contribution in a résumé or interview.
Keep this summary somewhere easy to revisit. Add another example whenever one comes to mind; it does not have to be a major milestone.
